## Knowledge Base Coverage of Top Support Categories

After exploring the `precision-kb-articles` index, I found partial coverage of the top ticket categories. The KB index stores articles with `category` and `tags` fields, but cross-referencing with ticket volumes required multiple attempts.

**Top ticket categories and KB article counts found:**

| Category | Ticket Count | KB Articles |
|---|---|---|
| Integration | 847 | 12 articles |
| Performance | 612 | 4 articles |
| Billing | 521 | 8 articles |
| API | 389 | 19 articles |
| Data quality | 298 | 3 articles |

**Observations:**

The API category is relatively well-documented (19 articles) despite lower ticket volume, suggesting good self-service coverage. Data quality is the most under-documented category — only 3 articles for 298 tickets. Integration articles exist but may not cover the specific connector failures driving the high ticket volume.

*Note: The KB index does not have a full-text search field — querying required filtering by `category` and `tags` fields separately. Several query attempts failed before the correct field structure was identified.*

turns.summary: Getting top ticket categories by volume
turns.input: FROM precision-support-tickets | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY category | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 5

turns.summary: Searching KB by text match — failed (no text field)
turns.input: FROM precision-kb-articles | WHERE content MATCH "integration" | STATS count = COUNT(*)

turns.summary: Counting KB articles by category field
turns.input: FROM precision-kb-articles | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY category | SORT count DESC

turns.summary: Filtering KB articles for integration category
turns.input: FROM precision-kb-articles | WHERE category == "integration" | KEEP title, tags | LIMIT 10

turns.summary: Filtering KB articles for billing category
turns.input: FROM precision-kb-articles | WHERE category == "billing" | KEEP title, tags | LIMIT 10

turns.summary: Searching KB by tags for performance issues
turns.input: FROM precision-kb-articles | WHERE tags LIKE "*performance*" | KEEP title, category, tags | LIMIT 10

turns.summary: Getting full KB coverage summary across all categories
turns.input: FROM precision-kb-articles | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY category | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10
